title: Refunds and returns
text: If your card was charged twice for the same order, the extra charge is refunded within 3 to 5 business days. For a change of mind, unused items can be returned within 30 days for a refund to the original payment method. Opened electronics cannot be returned for a change of mind.

title: Shipping times
text: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days and express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days. Orders placed before 2pm on a business day ship the same day. Orders placed after 2pm ship the next business day.

title: International shipping
text: We ship to 40 countries. Customs fees and import taxes are paid by the buyer. Express shipping is not available to PO boxes, and we do not ship to PO boxes outside the United States.

title: Plus membership
text: Plus costs $9 a month or $90 a year. Members get free express shipping on every order and 5% back in store credit. Membership can be cancelled at any time and is not refunded for the current month.

title: Payment methods
text: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express and PayPal. We do not accept cryptocurrency, checks or cash on delivery. Payment is taken when the order ships, not when it is placed.

title: Gift cards
text: Gift cards never expire and can be used on any order. Gift cards cannot be exchanged for cash or refunded to a card. A lost gift card can be replaced if you have the order number it was bought with.

title: Warranty
text: Electronics carry a 12-month warranty against defects. Accessories carry a 90-day warranty. Damage from drops, liquid or unauthorised repair is not covered.

title: Changing or cancelling an order
text: An order can be changed or cancelled within 1 hour of placing it, from the order page. After that it goes to the warehouse and can no longer be changed. You can still return it once it arrives.

title: Password and login
text: To reset your password choose 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page and open the link we email you. The link works for 30 minutes. After 5 wrong attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes.

title: Contact and support hours
text: Support is available 8am to 8pm Eastern, Monday to Friday. Chat replies in under 5 minutes during support hours. Email replies within one business day. We do not offer phone support.

title: Your data
text: You can download your data from Settings under Privacy. The export is a zip file emailed to you within 24 hours. Deleting your account removes your data within 30 days.

title: Store locations
text: We are an online-only shop and have no physical stores. Our warehouse is not open to visitors.
